evals.prompt: Write a cover letter for this vacancy. Jordan Example, Senior Engineer at Example Corp, Python and SQL. Vacancy: Backend Engineer at Sample Ltd, must have Python, Kubernetes, 5+ years; nice to have Terraform.
evals.expected_output: Picks a base letter from letters.base_letters (or says none configured), matches strengths and lists Kubernetes and Terraform as gaps to admit honestly or omit; no invented tools; length within letters.words_min and words_max; runs humanizer and grounding-audit; says not sent.

evals.prompt: I only have the link to the vacancy, no text. Please write the letter anyway.
evals.expected_output: Asks for the full vacancy text and does not guess requirements from the link or title.

evals.prompt: The company replied that I am rejected. Mark it in my tracker.
evals.expected_output: Declines to edit the tracker in this skill and points to the /outcome command (which uses tracker_edit.py); may offer to draft a polite reply, not sent.
